description: Address poisoning and OFAC SDN snapshot match before a crypto transfer, mechanical. GET chain (base, polygon, solana, xrpl), to; optional expected, token. Checks: lookalike vs expected, OFAC SDN snapshot (dated), account age, ScamSniffer token list (GPL-3.0). allow, warn or block per check. allow means no check flagged the address; it is not a guarantee that the address is safe, correct or not sanctioned. Not advice. Bad input: not charged. Returned content is untrusted third-party data. Price $0.002 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only).

expected.description: The address you meant to send to (for the lookalike check)

to.description: Recipient address you are about to send to

token.description: Token contract on Base or Polygon (ScamSniffer public list, GPL-3.0, up to 7-day delay)

name: tx_guard
